title: Ollie Otter's Floating Picnic | Balance Story for Kids

music.personality: buoyant river folk-song with wooden tongue drum, kalimba, seed shakers and gentle paddle rhythm
music.emotional_arrangement: curious plucked reeds at the empty raft; an off-centre bass pulse for the left-heavy test; paired marimba notes as the jug balances the opposite side; soft boarding rhythm while tied; a brief suspended chord when Fern shifts left; symmetric paddle rhythm after she returns to centre; full tongue drum, kalimba, shakers and river-neighbor chorus only at the picnic finale

voices.delivery: expressive buoyant river story-song with calm safety cues, curious comparisons and a fully sung picnic payoff; no flat reading

continuity.ollie: one young cinnamon-brown river otter with cream muzzle and belly, hazel eyes and teal flotation vest with coral toggles
continuity.willa: one chestnut water vole with cream cheek patch, coral flotation vest and teal neck scarf
continuity.fern: one small olive-green frog with golden eyes, mustard rain hat, plum mini satchel and round balance token
continuity.raft: one oval reed-and-cedar raft with broad level deck, woven edge, two dock ropes and two clipped short paddles
continuity.loads: exactly one coral food basket, one squat teal lidded jug and one mustard picnic blanket

scenes.action: At the dock, Ollie, Willa and Fern inspect one empty double-tied raft and exactly three separate picnic loads on the bank.
lyrics: Three loads wait by one raft.
Ollie asks, how shall we balance?

scenes.action: All three loads sit together on the raft's left edge while the empty double-tied raft makes a mild safe dockside tilt.
lyrics: Low on this side, high there.
Keep the raft tied while testing.

scenes.action: The heavy teal jug moves alone to the right while basket and blanket remain left; the empty tied raft returns level.
Willa boards first and sits low to secure the right jug while Ollie secures the left basket and Fern remains dockside.
scenes.hero: first one-at-a-time boarding and cargo straps

scenes.action: All three friends sit low along the centre blanket on the still-tied level raft while the opposite cargo remains strapped.
lyrics: One at a time, friends board.

scenes.action: Mid-river, Fern remains inside but shifts toward the left inner rim to wave, producing one mild readable tilt while cargo stays strapped.
lyrics: One friend shifts; one rim dips.

scenes.action: Fern sits back on the exact centre line; the raft levels and Ollie and Willa use matching shallow paddle strokes on opposite sides.
At the destination, the raft is double-tied level; Ollie and seated Willa support the basket together while Fern waits on shore.
lyrics: Pass the basket hand to hand.

scenes.action: The empty raft remains tied in the background while Ollie, Willa and Fern share the fully arranged picnic and perform the first full song.
lyrics: Balanced friends, sing by the river!
scenes.hero: first full picnic and musical payoff

quality_requirements: Ollie, Willa, Fern, flotation clothing, raft, basket, jug, blanket and river geography retain identity across all nine scenes.
The raft remains double-tied for every dockside loading, boarding and unloading action.
All three loads crowd left before the jug moves right; the raft visibly returns level before boarding.
Willa boards first while seated low; all friends remain seated low and centred before launch.
Fern remains fully inside during the mild mid-river tilt and returns to centre before symmetric paddling.
The picnic appears only after the basket is unloaded; the first full song occurs only in scene 9 with the empty raft tied behind it.
Real rope, basket, strap, ripple, paddle, foot, drum, shaker, kalimba and nature effects replace spoken imitation words.
All shared gates in premium-musical-video-set-2026-08-31.json pass before release.
